hooks.name: tab_complete
hooks.neoforge: none (NeoForge has no generic tab completion event)

rust_summary: A guest asked the server to complete a command (`native_tab_complete`).
doc_summary: A guest's server command completion request was evaluated: `native_tab_complete(player, name, command, range, suggestions)` lets a mod add or filter the suggestions; `range` is the replaced byte range. The guest's state is not swapped in, so helpers that look through `self.lan` may find nothing while its packet is handled. Bundles need "hooks": @API:tab_complete@.
